stemMd: In a stirred tank below the temperature threshold, no bottom sediment is present. Adding spring water produces cloudiness, while an otherwise matched tank receiving no spring water stays clear. Which model is most directly supported?
explanationMd: Cloudiness occurs without bottom sediment and below the warming threshold, but only with spring water. This matches the spring-mixing mechanism and conflicts with the sole-cause forms of the other two.

distractorRationale.b: There is no bottom sediment to lift.
distractorRationale.c: Both tanks remain below the threshold.
distractorRationale.d: The experiment supplies a required cause for only the spring model.
